newsitem.title: USA: Heska amends filing for 5.35 mln shr IPO.
newsitem.headline: Heska amends filing for 5.35 mln shr IPO.

text.p: Heska Corp said on Monday it has amended its registration statement for its 5.35 million share proposed initial public offering.
Of the 5,350,000 shares to be offered, 5,000,000 are to be offered by the company and 350,000 shares are to be offered by an existing stockholder, Heska said.
The reason for the amendment was not immediately available.

Heska, a maker of animal health products, said it will grant the underwriters an option to purchase an additional 802,500 shares to cover over allotments, if any. The price range is anticipated to be $14.00 to $16.00 per share.
The shares will be offered by an underwriting group managed by Credit Suisse First Boston Corporation and Merrill Lynch & Co.
Proceeds will be used for research and development, marketing activities, expansion of manufacturing capabilities, acquisitions, working capital and other general corporate purposes, Heska said.
